description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into Xero Contact records. Xero has no single-call upsert -- POST /Contacts is used for both create and update, with behavior determined by whether ContactID is present in the body (present = update; absent = create, and Xero enforces Name uniqueness across active contacts so a blind create risks a 400). This component looks up by lookup_field first (where= filter query) to discover an existing ContactID, then issues the appropriate create-or-update POST. Two API calls per row.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Xero Contact record (upserted via lookup_field; flat fields_map keys only, Phones/Addresses arrays not supported).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_errored / api_requests). No downstream data -- the write side effect lands in Xero.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql / csv / inline). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

lookup_field.label: Lookup Field
lookup_field.description: Xero Contact field used to find an existing record via a where= filter query. MUST be present in fields_map values -- Xero enforces Name uniqueness across active contacts.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column -> Xero Contact field name (flat fields only).

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap). No bulk endpoint -- each row costs 1 lookup + 1 write.

name: Xero Contact Upsert
